name: survarium::game::assign_music_emitter
evidence: Descriptive name: retains the resource in the selected music slot, stops/releases its old proxy, then calls play_music with 2000 ms and looping enabled; loading callback 0x20014bb60 selects slot 2.

name: survarium::game::play_music
evidence: Qualified diagnostic at 0x200956030; six slots; fades other playing proxies out over 2000 ms; selected slot receives duration and looping arguments; out-of-range track stops all slots.

name: survarium::loading_screen::on_music_loaded
evidence: Descriptive name: async callback installed at 0x20011b839 for mode/ui/loading_music; forwards the loaded single-sound resource to game::assign_music_emitter with slot 2.

name: vostok::sound::sound_instance_proxy::fade_out
evidence: Descriptive name: vtable 0x2009d7ae0 slot 4, queues duration and proxy to 0x200623400, which converts milliseconds to samples and enters propagator state 5.

name: survarium::player_input_handler::on_mouse_move
